title: Retrofit and proof-load a tool hanger on a captive keyed rail
instruction: Fit the hinged hanger around the stationary keyed rail between its fixed end stops. Close the halves with the rib in its groove and insert the orange-headed key through all three lugs. Hang the purple400g test weight by its eye on the projecting peg, then leave both hands clear; the loaded hanger must remain closed and clocked.
context: A split carrier can be installed on an anchored service rail without access to its ends. Its separate seam key and rib registration must support an independently placed offset payload; merely placing a collar is not the final operation.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. captive_shaft: rigid material, 1.2 kg, envelope (0.052, 0.25, 0.101) m, origin (0.33, 0, 0.8225), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). lower_collar: rigid material, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.12, 0.208, 0.0481299) m, origin (0.185, 0, 0.7717), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). upper_collar: rigid material, 0.1 kg, envelope (0.16, 0.208, 0.074) m, origin (0.185, 0, 0.7717), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). collar_key: rigid material, 0.025 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.093, 0.022) m, origin (0.36, -0.24, 0.7587), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). A longitudinal 3 mm wide shaft rib engages the groove in the upper collar. Upper handle local center (0.07,-0.16,0.025) m, with a 0.16-m support bar. Full collision geometry is in scene.json.
scoring: 0.25 for lower_half_located; 0.25 for collar_closed; 0.5 for collar_retained. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 2.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero. Lower-collar placement uses radial distance from the shaft Y axis at most1.5mm and independent axial offset at most1.5mm.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Fixed captive keyed rail and rigid split hanger with separate loose seam key. A real free400g handled weight rests by its V-shaped lifting eye on an outboard peg, producing an opening moment and rail clocking load. This is a custom temporary service-fixture surrogate, not a certified commercial clamp or rotating-shaft accessory. Geometry and prescribed masses are explicit; friction and material properties are approximate.
